description: Complete signup with the emailed code. When claiming a trial, nothing but the quota and the identity changes (credentials stay valid, no propagation wait). For a new account, generates the Ed25519 account signing keypair locally (only the public half is sent) and stores S3 credentials in ~/.obsideo/mcp.json; re-running that path rotates credentials and keypair with no overlap, so do not re-run to retry.
name: signup_verify
title: Complete Obsideo signup
